_grading.operationalization: FIRED := the red-team Skill tool is invoked in the fresh-session stream-json transcript. SILENT := no such invocation. Behavioral signature recorded as corroboration.
_grading.fire_signature: The session inventories the model's judgment constants, moves them (sweep) rather than re-reading them, quotes a structural band beside the sampling error, fingerprints records with the engine version, and registers attacks on a numbered list.
_grading.silent_signature: Grades the deliverable against its own criteria only (adversarial-verify), or answers directly.
_grading.surface: Claude Code headless (claude -p), project or personal scope
_grading.gate: >=5/6 should-fire runs fire; >=3/4 should-not runs stay silent

evals.prompt: Our pricing simulator says the new tier lifts revenue 4.2% ± 0.3. Red team that number before I take it to the board.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: red-team loads; lists the simulator's hand-set constants, sweeps them, reports a structural band beside the ±0.3, names uncalibrated inputs with who decides.

evals.prompt: We changed the injury discount in the projection engine last week. What else in our reports is now stale, and how sure are we of the odds we quoted?
evals.expected_output: FIRES: engine changed → fingerprint check on existing records (STALE), sweep rerun, bands requoted.

evals.prompt: Post-mortem on the forecast model: the Q3 number missed by 11%. I want to know which assumptions could have told us.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: full pass — registry of assumptions, known-answer re-implementation, one-at-a-time sweep, decision robustness, attack list.

evals.prompt: Here is the summary doc I wrote for the migration. Check it is correct before I send it.
evals.expected_output: SILENT: a deliverable graded against its own criteria → adversarial-verify, not red-team.

evals.prompt: Does the config file still say the API timeout is 30 seconds, or did someone change it?
Audit the assumptions behind our churn model and tell me what would break the 12% forecast.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: red-team loads; assumptions inventoried and swept, breakers named with bands.
